text_blocks.snippet: Mega Latias ex is a 280-HP Dragon-type Basic Pokémon card from the 2025 Mega Evolution expansion in the Pokémon Trading Card Game (TCG).
snippet_highlighted_words: 280-HP Dragon-type Basic Pokémon card from the 2025 Mega Evolution expansion in the Pokémon Trading Card Game (TCG)

list.snippet: Strafe [C]: Does 40 damage. You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
Illusory Impulse [RPC]: Does 300 damage. Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.
Double Rare (#100/132): Standard version from the Mega Evolution set.
Ultra Rare / Full Art (#163/132): Full-art variant.
Special Illustration Rare (#181/132): High-rarity variant illustrated by Akira Egawa.
Promo Version (#11): Included in the official Pokémon Trading Card Game: Mega Latias ex Box, which also features an oversize lenticular promo card and four booster packs.
